rationale: The bid-ask spread of 3434 bps makes this instrument effectively untradeable intraday — any entry would immediately face a ~34% round-trip cost, making profitable execution nearly impossible regardless of direction. The price is sitting exactly at today's low with only two 1-minute candles of data (one of which is a massive gap-down candle), providing no reliable structure for invalidation or target placement. Combined with a gapping, illiquid tape in a risk-off session (SPY -1.11%, VIXY +5.88%), the risk/reward is undefined and the mechanical edge is absent.
